insights.content: This quarter could be the start of a 'supercycle' for investment banking, driven by expected IPOs, pent-up transaction demand, falling interest rates, and optimism around deals.

US banks have historically always beaten analyst expectations in the past 15-20 years, but beating expectations does not always lead to stock price increases due to 'whispering' (unofficial higher expectations).
